_readme: SIMULATOR FIXTURES, NOT GAME CONTENT. Synthetic enemies for Tooling/BalanceSim's PvE mode, so the roster can be measured against PvE-shaped fights (one huge enemy, a swarm, a mixed pack). They are not roster beasts, no game code reads this file, and nothing here is a design decision about real encounters. BaseStats are max-level values scaled by the roster growth curve named in GrowthCurveId (as a beast's are); the simulator then calibrates one difficulty multiplier per encounter, level and kit mode, so only the ratios inside a stat line matter. Elements are cycled over a group's units. Every group's MoveRange + longest SingleTarget range must cover the arena's front-row gap (Medium 6, Large 8), because BattleTurnExecutor never makes a partial approach; the fixtures go further and span the whole board so back ranks engage too. See Tooling/BalanceSim/README.md.

Encounters.Description: One huge enemy: very high HP, heavy single-target hits in both categories every turn, and a periodic area slam. Elementless by default so the boss measures stat lines; use --enemy-element for an elemental variant.

Twenty-four small enemies with low HP and weak melee: half bite (Physical), half sting (Special), so neither defence is favoured. Elements cycle through all ten. Move 13 spans the Large board: its zones are 8 apart, the back rank is further, and there is no partial approach.
Six mid-size enemies: three fast Physical melee hunters in front, three Special casters behind them at range 3. Six different elements.
